subject: Amendments Required to Draft Bill of Lading
body:
Dear Partner,

We have reviewed the draft Bill of Lading against the authoritative Shipping Instruction and found discrepancies that require your attention.

Specifically, the Consignee is listed as UAB NOVAKOPA on the draft Bill of Lading, whereas the Shipping Instruction states EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC.

Additionally, the Notify Party is listed as UAB NOVAKOPA on the draft Bill of Lading, but the Shipping Instruction states EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC.

Please amend the draft Bill of Lading to match the Shipping Instruction at your earliest convenience.

Sincerely,
Shipping Operations
